sourceText: 根据 docs/requirements/decisions/dynamic-finding-system-execution-plan.md 按顺序执行三个 Story；每个 Story 先用 RED 证明仍存在的历史问题，再用 GREEN 修复，并完整经过 DEV、REVIEW、TEST、DONE。第一步是 Finding Ledger and Runtime Evidence Integrity，完成后才执行 Finding Identity and Historical Lineage，最后执行 Dynamic Finding Applicability。
normalizedOutcome: The first dependency Story finishes with exactly-once Finding ledger mutations and fresh signed runtime evidence, proven by executable RED-to-GREEN evidence before either dependent Story starts.
acceptanceClaim: The final Story 3 smoke prints Finding ledger integrity: PASS and Runtime evidence integrity: PASS while the CLI dependency graph keeps B-03b7 and B-e6d9 blocked until B-fe8f is DONE.
